description: This file contains functions for normalizing and transforming Torch JIT IR operations, including alias normalization, rsub normalization, and boolean comparison normalization, as well as a map of operator aliases.

methods.name: normalizeOpAliases
methods.description: Normalizes operator aliases in the IR node iterator.

methods.name: normalizeRSub
methods.description: Replaces 'rsub' operations with 'sub' operations by swapping inputs.

methods.name: normalizeIsBool
methods.description: Converts '__is__' and '__isnot__' comparisons with booleans to 'eq' and 'ne'.

methods.name: NormalizeOps
methods.description: Recursively normalizes operations within a block and its sub-blocks.
